propositions: A standing eval spec for the concurrency overlay does not exist, leaving prompt edits vulnerable to silent regressions in recall and precision behavior established by traced bug corpus.

The eval spec must define deterministic scorers (code_review_emits_valid_findings, code_review_recall, code_review_no_fire), 3 epochs, and a gate of at_least(2) gating epochs to validate prompt behavior against minimal diff hunks distilled from production races.

Gating dataset must include at least 2 recall cases (unlocked twin and check-then-act TOCTOU) and at least 3 no-fire cases (write lock addition, atomic-write conversion, and deliberate probe-then-skip with real lock), each with provenance comments naming source commits.
R3 (fail-open guard) is a known-hard non-gating stretch case that should be present as a commented hunk block (not a scored case) so it is tracked but cannot fail the gate by construction.
The spec header must document that coverage_threshold is a run-success floor and the only per-run tolerance is at_least(2) over 3 epochs.
Validation via rebar prompt eval code-review-concurrency must exit 0, confirming the spec is well-formed and scorers/gate resolve correctly.
